skill.name: openai-docs-skill
skill.description: Search and fetch official OpenAI developer documentation through the OpenAI Docs MCP server with a curl and jq CLI wrapper. Use it for current guidance on OpenAI APIs, SDKs, ChatGPT Apps, Codex, MCP, endpoint schemas, parameters, limits, and migrations.
skill.summary: Search and fetch official OpenAI developer documentation from a CLI-based MCP wrapper.
skill.author: am-will

security_audit.summary: Most static external-command findings are Markdown or safe shell substitutions that do not evaluate user input as code. The real security considerations are intended outbound requests to the OpenAI Docs MCP endpoint and the configurable MCP_URL override.

remediation.issue: MCP_URL can point the wrapper at any endpoint.
remediation.suggestion: Default to the official endpoint and require explicit confirmation or allow-listing before using any non-OpenAI MCP_URL value.

remediation.issue: Documentation queries are sent to a remote service.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users not to include secrets, proprietary code, or customer data in search terms or fetched URLs.

static_findings.snippet: MCP_URL  Override the MCP endpoint (default: https://developers.openai.com/mcp)
- Query the MCP server via the CLI wrapper in `scripts/openai-docs-mcp.sh` (do not rely on Codex MCP
- Use `search` or `list` to find the best doc page, then `fetch` the page (or anchor) for exact text
1. Discover: `search` with a focused query. If unsure, use `list` to browse.
2. Read: `fetch` the most relevant URL (optionally add an anchor).
The CLI wrapper is at `scripts/openai-docs-mcp.sh` and uses `curl` + `jq` against `https://developer

- `search <query> [limit] [cursor]`: return JSON hits from the docs index.
- `fetch <url> [anchor]`: return markdown for a doc page or section.
- `openapi <endpoint-url> [lang1,lang2] [code-only]`: fetch OpenAPI schema or code samples.

semantic_findings.title: Configurable Remote MCP Endpoint
semantic_findings.description: The script allows MCP_URL to replace the official docs endpoint, and the skill documents this override. A hostile or accidental value could send documentation queries and requested URLs to an untrusted server.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The endpoint override is explicit in the script and documented in the skill. Exploitation depends on environment control, so confidence is high for the behavior and moderate for abuse likelihood.

content.value_statement: OpenAI platform details change quickly, and stale memory can cause incorrect code. This skill queries official OpenAI documentation through a CLI wrapper and returns sourced guidance.
actual_capabilities: Searches official OpenAI developer documentation through the Docs MCP endpoint.
Fetches markdown for a selected OpenAI documentation page or anchor.
Lists available documentation pages and API endpoints.
Retrieves OpenAPI schema details or code sample text for endpoint URLs.
Provides a CLI workflow based on curl and jq.
limitations: Requires curl, jq, and network access.
Only covers documentation exposed by the OpenAI Docs MCP server.
Depends on the availability and accuracy of the remote MCP service.
Does not run project tests or validate local implementation behavior.

use_cases.title: API Migration Planning
use_cases.description: Check current Responses API migration guidance before changing request flows.

use_cases.title: SDK Usage Validation
use_cases.description: Fetch current SDK examples before adding model features to an AI application.

use_cases.title: Support Answer Sourcing
use_cases.description: Collect official URLs for answers about Codex, MCP, or ChatGPT Apps.

prompt_templates.title: Find the Right Guide
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the OpenAI docs skill to search for official guidance on the Responses API. Summarize the best page and include the URL.

prompt_templates.title: Verify an SDK Parameter
prompt_templates.prompt: Search the OpenAI documentation for the current meaning of this SDK parameter. Explain the answer and cite the source URL.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Migration Paths
prompt_templates.prompt: Find official OpenAI migration guidance for my API change. List the main differences, risks, and source pages.

prompt_templates.title: Fetch Endpoint Details
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the docs MCP endpoint tools to find the relevant OpenAPI endpoint details. Summarize parameters, response shape, and official references.

output_examples.input: Search for Responses API migration guidance.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a concise migration summary, key endpoint changes, and the official guide URL.

output_examples.input: Fetch documentation for a specific OpenAI endpoint.
output_examples.output: The skill provides the endpoint purpose, important parameters, response notes, and the source link.
The skill identifies matching pages, ranks likely matches, and states which official URL was used.

best_practices: Use focused queries with product, API, and task names.
Include documentation URLs in final answers so users can verify sources.
Review fetched docs before applying guidance to production code.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on memory when the user asks for latest OpenAI behavior.
Do not send secrets or private customer data in documentation searches.
Do not override MCP_URL to untrusted endpoints.

faq.question: Does this skill use official OpenAI sources?
faq.answer: Yes. The default endpoint is the OpenAI Docs MCP service.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: Yes. It needs network access, curl, and jq to query the MCP server.

faq.question: Can it answer non-OpenAI documentation questions?
faq.answer: No. It is specialized for OpenAI developer documentation.

faq.question: Does it run code in my project?
faq.answer: No. The wrapper sends documentation queries and formats responses.

faq.question: Can I change the MCP endpoint?
faq.answer: Yes, through MCP_URL. Use only trusted endpoints.
